meaning: Kernel generic cache references; cache level, prefetch and request scope are CPU/kernel dependent.
Kernel generic cache misses; not guaranteed to be demand-load or LLC misses.
Kernel L1D read-access mapping; speculative versus retired scope must be checked per CPU.
Kernel L1D read-miss mapping; may count refills rather than retired misses.
Kernel L1D write-access mapping; the read-only kernel should have little store activity.
Kernel last-level read-access mapping; do not assume identical LLC domains across CPUs.
Kernel last-level read-miss mapping; interpretation depends on CPU and firmware.
Kernel data-TLB read-miss mapping; may mean page walks rather than L1 TLB misses.
